Signs of the World

About

I’ve always been envious of those who are bilingual. Speaking another language feels like a superpower. The Star Trek universal translator is the ultimate tool, after the replicator.

I’d argue universal symbols are the next best thing. They combine graphic design, language, and art into something that’s functional and, more often than not, beautiful.

Signs of the World is a collection of signs and symbols that represent our best efforts at a universal language. It’s also a love letter to designers working each day to tackle problems on a global scale.
